messages:
sam: nodes in us-west2-gpupool are flipping to NotReady/NoSchedule, noticed ~20% of GPU nodes this morning. pods stuck Pending.
priya: ugh, same. device-plugin is in CrashLoopBackOff on several nodes. I see `nvidia-firmware: coldplug timeout` in kernel logs.
marta: can you paste the kubelet + device-plugin logs?
sam: here —
```
KERNEL: nvidia: firmware request timeout
kubelet: kubelet: device plugin registry: failed to register plugin: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = no devices reported
nvidia-device-plugin: panic: failed to init devices: timed out waiting for device probe
```

alex: sounds like coldplug where the GPU doesn't finish init before device-plugin starts. we've seen this with certain kernel + firmware combos on newer instance types.
priya: which instance types? these are G5a-ish (ampere) preemptible pool.
sam: yes preemptible g5a-ish. also noticed instance startup is sometimes slower in us-west2-c.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: cluster-autoscaler scaled up 5 nodes in us-west2-gpupool at 2024-06-13T09:07:22Z.
oncall: autoscaler may be looping — nodes come up but kubelet marks NotReady then they don't accept GPU workloads so pods stay Pending -> autoscaler keeps adding. cost risk.
marta: quick mitigations: 1) add startup probe delay for device-plugin daemonset (wait for /dev/nvidiactl), 2) add `--node-status-update-frequency` bump? 3) gate the device-plugin with a systemd `After=dev-nvidia.device`?
alex: practical: add an init script to node image that runs `udevadm settle --exit-if-exists=/dev/nvidia0 --timeout=60` before kubelet joins. easier than changing driver.
priya: can we cordon/scale-down the preemptible pool until we patch images?
sam: cordoned and drained 6 bad nodes, but large backlog remains — ~130 GPU pods Pending.
oncall: action: roll a new image to the gpupool with `udevadm settle` + bump device-plugin start to use `--socket=/var/lib/kubelet/device-plugins/nvidia.sock --health-port=3210 --timeout=60s` (example).
marta: also recommend driver bump to 535.86 — fixes a firmware probe race we've seen in internal lab tests.
alex: schedule: build AMI + test in staging gpupool (2 nodes), then rollout canary 10% of pool. estimated 2h to validate.
priya: note: preemptible nodes frequently reclaim -> if we rely on longer init, autoscaler config must accept longer provisioning time (scale-up-delay). update CA config?
oncall: i'll raise CA scale-up timeout to 6m for the gpupool temporarily.
sam: i'll create PR for the init script + device-plugin args and the AMI bake. tagging @marta to run driver validation.
marta: ack — i'll run kernel/firmware compatibility test matrix against 535.x and the image. will post results.
alex: postmortem candidate if this recurs. cost note: autoscaler churn added ~3k USD in extra nodes during the last 4h. ops to monitor.
priya: temporary: add taint `gpu-init=retry:NoSchedule` to new nodes so critical system pods don't land until device-plugin healthy.
oncall: created incident ticket INC-2024-4597 and assigned to eng-infra.
sam: thanks — i'll follow up with a short rollback plan and ETA when the AMI bake passes. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Note: next on-call handover at 2024-06-13T12:00:00Z.
